title: events
summary: Benilla's events.rs/decode.rs is the full typed decode dispatch over ~205 opcodes. MSUI's counterpart is the GameLoop.Net dispatch switch plus per-feature parsers, which covers the large majority, now including strict SMSG_SPELL_UPDATE_CHAIN_TARGETS routing into the caster-owned chain-beam lifecycle. The formerly aggregated channel moderation/list gap is closed; any remaining smaller polish/feedback packets require a fresh itemized audit.

openItems.text: Cooldown follow-ups: SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT, SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN, SMSG_ITEM_COOLDOWN, SMSG_COOLDOWN_CHEAT (only SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN is handled)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: strict decoders and live dispatch now cover ITEM_COOLDOWN, COOLDOWN_EVENT, CLEAR_COOLDOWN and COOLDOWN_CHEAT with exact player/pet addressing and store mutations; focused clinical and production builds pass.

openItems.text: Group loot rolls: SMSG_LOOT_START_ROLL, SMSG_LOOT_ROLL, SMSG_LOOT_ROLL_WON, SMSG_LOOT_ALL_PASSED
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: the four group-loot server events are strict-parsed, dispatched, rendered, announced in loot chat, and resolution-closes are idempotent.
2026-08-21: START/PAUSE/STOP are strict-parsed, dispatched, integrated, and rendered in the fixed three-bar pool.

2026-08-22: all four world-audio/weather events have strict packet decoders and network dispatch. Weather sound participates in the one ambience selector with outdoor-only replacement and the standard five-second crossfade; weather rendering remains separately tracked under systems/terrain.

openItems.text: SMSG_SPELL_UPDATE_CHAIN_TARGETS remains unhandled. SMSG_CHANNEL_LIST and SMSG_SET_PROFICIENCY are strict-decoded and dispatched; proficiency drives item-tooltip colors plus vendor usability, while SMSG_EXPLORATION_EXPERIENCE and SMSG_LEVELUP_INFO are decoded and applied.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: SMSG_SPELL_UPDATE_CHAIN_TARGETS now strict-decodes raw caster/target GUIDs and u32 count, dispatches in spell-event order, and feeds the same caster-owned hop list as SPELL_GO before the chain CharProc consumes it. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Mount feedback: SMSG_MOUNTSPECIAL_ANIM, SMSG_MOUNTRESULT, and SMSG_DISMOUNTRESULT.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: SMSG_MOUNTSPECIAL_ANIM strict-decodes its raw u64 rider GUID and dispatches AnimationData 94 with self-echo suppression; mount and dismount result feedback is also decoded and displayed.

openItems.text: Taxi extras: SMSG_NEW_TAXI_PATH, CMSG_ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS (base taxi node/activate flow IS implemented)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: empty-body SMSG_NEW_TAXI_PATH is dispatched with discovery feedback, and route activation now selects and serializes CMSG_ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS when no direct TaxiPath edge exists.

openItems.text: SMSG_SPLINE_SET_* observer speed family remains unhandled. The complete six-kind SMSG/CMSG_FORCE_* speed-change/ack family is now implemented and focused-wire checked.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The complete SPLINE_SET and MOVE_SET observer speed families strict-decode and dispatch to addressed entity speed state without acknowledgements; MOVE_SET's embedded MovementInfo also drives the remote-player pose interpolator.

openItems.text: SMSG_ITEM_ENCHANT_TIME_UPDATE; SMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE. SMSG_INVENTORY_CHANGE_FAILURE is now decoded and dispatched.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: both SMSG_ITEM_ENCHANT_TIME_UPDATE and SMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE are strictly decoded and dispatched; inventory-change failures were already implemented.

openItems.text: The remaining aggregate event gap is the channel moderation/list surface tracked under protocol/channel and protocol/client. Duel, played time, random roll, corpse query, area-trigger message, chat player-not-found/wrong-faction, spirit-healer confirm, and durability-damage-death are dispatched.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: strict CHANNEL_NOTIFY/LIST receive dispatch was already present and the complete outbound moderation block is now implemented and reachable, closing the aggregate channel surface tracked by this item.
